source: Schneider Electric press release: Schneider Electric and AMD release first Helios platform (07-22-2026)

players.product: EcoStruxure UPS, PDU, prefab modular datacenter blocks

quarterly_data.signal: Schneider Electric and AMD released a jointly developed and validated reference design for the AMD Helios rack-scale solution (AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs, 6th Gen AMD EPYC CPUs, AMD Pensando Vulcano NICs), which the companies call the first ever developed for high-density AI workloads on Helios and the first milestone of their collaboration. The design supports 246 kW AI racks and modular AI clusters of up to 10.4 MW IT capacity for greenfield deployments, uses Motivair by Schneider Electric CDU-based and hybrid air/liquid cooling capable of removing up to 84% of heat, and targets PUE as low as ~1.12 at full load. It is validated to ANSI standards for U.S. deployments, with plans to extend it to IEC standards for global implementations in the future. A reference design (blueprint), not a supply contract; no orders or customers stated.
